legenda: Mellow lo-fi boom bap hip hop, late-night study mood, reflective and hopeful, male lead vocals rapping in Brazilian Portuguese with a clear rhythmic flow and a sung melodic chorus, dusty sampled drums, vinyl crackle, warm Rhodes chords, deep round bass, soft jazzy guitar licks, subtle turntable scratches, head-nodding groove, high fidelity, professional mix
inspiracao: O assistente de estudos do Guilherme e a provocação do professor, explicar com pesca para quem gosta de pescar, viram um rap de madrugada.
descricao: Rap boom bap com base lo-fi sobre um assistente que resume a apostila, faz perguntas e explica com pesca para quem gosta de rio.
